_comment: Louisiana 2025 QAP Section IV threshold requirements (pp.13-19), selected. Appendix A section VI (H-K) acknowledges four of them (30% AMI, resiliency, eviction prevention, Wi-Fi), which are coded here at their Section IV sources. Omitted: IV.A.2 (resiliency detail for new construction), A.15-17, A.19, IV.B.1-4 and the Section IV.C bond requirements.
